name: voice.elevenlabs
title: Voice (ElevenLabs)
summary: Synthesize one line of speech with ElevenLabs and write take.mp3 plus take.wav. Optional provider: it needs an elevenlabs_api_key secret file and network access.
description: Performs a scripted line with an ElevenLabs voice, supporting v3 audio tags such as [whispers] or [excited] inside the text. It writes the raw MP3 response as take.mp3 and always also decodes it to take.wav. The API key is read from the elevenlabs_api_key secret file and never appears in results or logs. Requests are retried on 429, 5xx and network errors.

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice id (for example 21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM). Use voice.elevenlabs-voices to list ids.

text.description: The line to speak. May contain v3 audio tags such as [whispers], [excited] or [laughs], which the eleven_v3 model performs.

model.description: ElevenLabs model id; eleven_v3 acts the tags in the text.

similarity.description: Similarity boost to the original voice (maps to similarity_boost).

seed.description: Seed for deterministic generation when the model supports it; omit for varied takes.

language.description: Optional ISO language code (maps to language_code), for example en.

output_format.description: Requested output format; mp3_44100_128 is the best the ElevenLabs Free tier allows.

chars.description: Number of characters billed (length of the text).

seconds.description: Duration of the decoded take in seconds.

request_id.description: ElevenLabs request-id response header, or null when absent.

model.description: The model id that was used.

voice_id.description: The voice id that was used.
